title: Completed scalar shift chain equation and representative normalization predicates
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in one coefficient universe, a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-embedding $\iota:E\to L$, and a scheme $Y$ in an independent universe. Use the completed coefficient sheaves $R_E,R_L$, ordinary tensor functor $A$, its termwise complex functor $A_c$, ordinary derived scalar extension $F$, strict Roos complex functor $C$, chain comparison $c:A_c\to C$, derived comparison $\chi:F\to T$, and universal counit $\epsilon_P:F(QP)\to Q(A_cP)$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Here $T$ is the strict derived scalar extension of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Write $Q$ for complex localization and $\eta_{P,m}:Q(P[m])\simeq(QP)[m]$ for its standard comparison [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A good complex is a K-flat complex with flat terms [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex]. Use the fixed product reindexing, signed mapping-cocone predicate $\operatorname{ConeFormula}(e_C,P,m)$, strict derived normalization predicate $\operatorname{IntegralNormalization}(e_C,e_T)$ and coherent integer shift convention of [def-pur-completed-scalar-shift-coordinates]. In particular, $P[m]^j=P^{j+m}$ and $d_{P[m]}^j=(-1)^m d_P^{j+m}$. The termwise tensor shift $a_{m,P}:A_c(P[m])\simeq A_c(P)[m]$ is the canonical additive tensor reindexing.

For a coherent integer shift structure $e_C$ on $C$, define $\operatorname{completedScalarShiftChainEquation}(e_C)$ to mean that for every complex $P$ of $R_E$-module sheaves and every integer $m$,
$$c_P[m]\circ a_{m,P}=e_{C,m,P}\circ c_{P[m]}.$$
Both sides are chain maps $A_c(P[m])\to C(P)[m]$.

For a coherent integer shift structure $e_F$ on $F$, define $\operatorname{completedScalarShiftOrdinaryNormalization}(e_F)$ to mean that for every good complex $P$ and every integer $m$,
$$\epsilon_P[m]\circ e_{F,m,QP}=\eta_{A_cP,m}\circ Q(a_{m,P})\circ\epsilon_{P[m]}\circ F(\eta_{P,m}^{-1}).$$
Both sides are morphisms $F((QP)[m])\to Q(A_cP)[m]$.

For coherent integer shift structures $e_C,e_F,e_T$ on $C,F,T$, respectively, define $\operatorname{completedScalarShiftRepresentativeProperty}(e_C,e_F,e_T)$ to be the conjunction of: $\operatorname{ConeFormula}(e_C,P,m)$ for every complex $P$ and integer $m$; $\operatorname{completedScalarShiftChainEquation}(e_C)$; $\operatorname{completedScalarShiftOrdinaryNormalization}(e_F)$; $\operatorname{IntegralNormalization}(e_C,e_T)$; and the natural-transformation shift square
$$\chi_K[m]\circ e_{F,m,K}=e_{T,m,K}\circ\chi_{K[m]}$$
for every derived object $K$ and integer $m$. These are definitions of three predicates, with no assertion that compatible shift structures exist.
